label: agent
scenario: Clinic's LLM voice receptionist discloses it is virtual, books a vet vaccine slot, reads back a confirmation number and says a text was sent.
task: Book a rabies booster appointment for the customer's dog at the vet clinic.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you for calling Maple Hollow Veterinary Clinic. I'm Juniper, the clinic's virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hi Juniper. I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of my customer, Priya Raman. I'd like to book a rabies booster for her dog, Biscuit.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can help with that. Is Biscuit an existing patient with us?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Yes, he is. The account should be under Raman, with a phone number ending in 4417.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks. I found Biscuit, a four-year-old beagle. His last rabies vaccine was given in October 2023, so he's due. I have openings on Wednesday at 9:40 AM or Thursday at 3:15 PM.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. I've booked Biscuit for a rabies booster on Thursday, September 17th at 3:15 PM with Dr. Okafor. Your confirmation number is M H V 5 5 8 2 1. I've also sent a text confirmation to the number on file.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, that's M H V 5 5 8 2 1, Thursday the 17th at 3:15.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's correct. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring any previous vaccine records if you have them. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day.
